column1: # What build/typst/fetch.sh fetches into the image, one tab-separated row each:
#   <path in the image>  <url at a pinned commit>  <sha256>  <licence (SPDX)>
# Every URL names a commit, never a branch, and fetch.sh refuses a file whose
# SHA-256 differs. The image copies this file to /licenses/fetch.tsv.
# fonts/: the Noto set for every script the reports may hold (plan
#     published builds, hinted TTF: Latin, Greek and Cyrillic (Sans, Serif,
#     Mono), Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari and eight more Indic scripts,
#   - notofonts/noto-cjk @ f8d15753 (2024-09-19), the region subset OTFs:
# licenses/fonts/: the OFL text of each source repository at a pinned commit.
# typst-packages/: the cmarker Typst package 0.1.10 (MIT), from typst/packages
#   @ 4c140e78 (2026-07-03), laid out as Typst's local package directory
